kicker: Itinerary bheji, client ne kahin aur book kiya
title: PDF itinerary bheja. *Client ne compare karke* kahin aur book kiya.
message:
Hi [naam] 🌴 [Goa] trip ke 2 options ready hain:
A) Budget: ₹[X] (3★, breakfast)
B) Comfort: ₹[Y] (4★, airport pick-up)
*[date] tak* is rate pe hold hai. A ya B?
why: ek PDF = homework. *2 options + deadline* = decision. "A ya B" ka jawab aasaan hai.
caption:
Travel enquiry ka 80% kaam itinerary banana hai, aur client usi PDF ko doosre agent ko dikha deta hai. ✈️

24 ghante baad:
1️⃣ 2 options (budget / comfort)
2️⃣ Price clear
3️⃣ Rate hold ki deadline
4️⃣ "A ya B?"

Save karo 🔖
